title: OpenAerialMap imagery, CC BY-NC 4.0
description: The 2,039 OpenAerialMap scenes licensed [CC BY-NC 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/), mirrored from the [OpenAerialMap STAC API](https://api.imagery.hotosm.org/stac/collections/openaerialmap) on 2026-10-06. Scenes come from drones (604), aircraft (39) and satellites (1,396), uploaded since 2015 by individuals, mapping communities, governments and companies. Each scene is one STAC item whose Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF stays on OpenAerialMap's storage; items are grouped into one subcatalog per acquisition year. Search every scene at once through items.parquet. Each item names its own producer, who is the party to credit. Agents start at [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/geospatialjeff/oam-portolan/oam-cc-by-nc-4-0/AGENTS.md).
